title: ConstitutionalExperts: Training a Mixture of Principle-based Prompts
reasoning: The paper focuses on a method for prompt optimization and evaluates it on text classification tasks such as toxicity, hate speech, and policy violations. While it uses datasets like ETHOS that include religion and race as protected categories for detecting hate speech, the core of the paper is technical prompt engineering rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or complex ethical and moral frameworks.
